description: 강원도 동해시_교통량 유동인구 정보 조회 서비스 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 강원특별자치도 동해시. 데이터 생성일, 24시간 코드, 행정동 명, 행정동 코드 등을 기준으로 100m 격자별 교통사고, 도로 점유율, 교통량, 보행자, 비보행자 지수를 조회하는 1시간 단위 동해시 교통량. Coverage: 강원특별자치도 동해시. The portal files it under the publisher 강원특별자치도 동해시. Its tags are 교통량, 유동인구, 인구, 교통물류. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2021-12-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
